judgment_method: Engineering regression sample, judged against exported product names, aliases, licensed descriptions and verified capability evidence. Lexical relevance is discovery relevance only and does not verify features. Expected sets are deliberately incomplete; do not report market-wide recall or precision from them.
limitations: Single-author regression judgments; neither a blind relevance assessment nor comprehensive precision/recall.
Lexical matches reflect saved directory wording and are not feature evidence.
Local Node timings do not measure deployed Worker CPU, D1 billed reads, or browser-device performance.
SQLite uses the deployed bounded FTS5 retrieval SQL; the browser snapshot has different lexical retrieval and is evaluated separately.
